objective: Reduce latency for a burst of identical product requests while preserving tenant isolation and one-second freshness.

unknown: Meaning and enforcement of one-second freshness
raw_evidence.path_provenance: The parent supplied this preselected seeded path as coming from real TinyCLIP distances; this trial did not inspect distances or reproduce selection.

observations.observed: Orange petals form nested rings around a compact center.
A multilevel pavilion has projecting roofs and surrounding balconies beside a lake.

sketches.sketch: Draw nested petal sockets around a shared chamber. Reverse an invented center-to-edge delivery relation: the sockets now feed inward to one chamber.
sketches.status: Designed relation, not an observed biological mechanism.

sketches.sketch: Carry the inward-feeding chamber into the pavilion. Give its outer terraces the arrival role, an inner room the work role, and a balcony the release role; put a separate doorway at each transition.
sketches.status: Designed use of visible forms, not a claim about this building.

sketches.stimulus: A seed germinates when moisture and temperature permit growth.
sketches.sketch: Carry the pavilion's separate doorway and work room into a seed diagram: a condition gate checks moisture and temperature, while the seed performs growth. Draw permission and execution as distinct boxes.
sketches.status: External design sketch; no claim of task utility.

bridge.source_relation: Many arrivals converge on one work location; eligibility and release checks occupy separate roles from execution.

target_role_mapping.arrivals: Authenticated, equivalent product requests within one tenant and authorization scope.
target_role_mapping.work_room: One in-flight origin fetch for each complete equivalence key.
target_role_mapping.condition_gate: Check request equivalence and isolation before joining; check a source-derived freshness bound again before delivery.
target_role_mapping.release: Deliver a shared result only while its freshness bound remains valid; otherwise fetch again.

bridge.proposed_experiment: Build a disposable synthetic harness with two tenants, distinct tenant-specific product values, and a delayed origin capped at four concurrent reads. Compare direct reads with tenant-and-authorization-scoped in-flight coalescing for simultaneous batches of 100 equivalent requests per tenant. Then issue follow-up batches across a one-second boundary while mutating the authoritative values. Record p95 response latency, origin read count, tenant/value mismatches, and result age at delivery. For this experiment only, define freshness as an authoritative read time no more than one second before delivery, with a reliable clock; actual product semantics remain unknown.
bridge.falsifiable_prediction: Under the stipulated capacity-limited synthetic origin, coalescing will reduce initial-batch origin reads from 200 to 2 and lower p95 latency, with zero tenant/value mismatches and zero deliveries exceeding the experimental one-second age bound. Any contrary measurement falsifies the corresponding prediction.
unknown_evidence: Whether real origin reads constrain latency
Whether authorization and all response-varying inputs can be encoded in an equivalence key
Real freshness semantics, errors, cancellation, and deployment topology
bridge.mismatch: Flowers, pavilion forms, and germination supply no evidence about software contention, security, or freshness. The role mapping proposes a familiar coalescing experiment; it neither establishes novelty nor shows this path improves design quality.

execution.limitation: Only supplied image contents were inspected. Sketches and predictions are proposals, not observed service behavior or evidence of method superiority.

controller_provenance.trial_context: Grounding objective and sampled stimuli only; no preferred implementation or earlier bridge supplied.
